::: {#exm-warmup}

#### Warmup to 0.1 over 100 steps

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
target_rate, n_warmup_steps = 0.1, 100
warmup_rates = {t: target_rate * (t + 1) / n_warmup_steps for t in [0, 49, 99]}
print(warmup_rates)
```

With $T_w = 100$ and $\learnrate = 0.1$,
[learning-rate warmup](#def-warmup) uses [learning rate](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-learning-rate) `r py$warmup_rates[["0"]]` at step 0,
`r py$warmup_rates[["49"]]` at step 49,
and `r py$warmup_rates[["99"]]` at step 99,
the last step of the [warmup](#def-warmup).

:::
